articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Brain tumor is a life-threatening disease that can disrupt normal brain functioning and have a significant impact on a patient’s quality of life. Early detection and diagnosis are crucial for effective treatment. In recent years, deep learning techniques for image analysis and detection have played a vital role in the medical field, supplying more accurate and reliable results. Segmentation, the process of distinguishing between normal and abnormal brain cells or tissues, is a critical step in the detection of brain tumors. In this research, we aim to investigate various techniques for brain tumor detection and segmentation using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) images. The detection process begins by analyzing the symmetric and asymmetric shape of the brain to identify abnormalities. We will then classify the cells as either Tumored or non-Tumored. This research is aimed at finding a more accurate and efficient method for detecting brain tumors. Four Keras models are compared side by side to find out the best deep learning model for providing a suitable outcome. The models are ResNet50, DenseNet201, Inception V3 and MobileNet. These models gave training accuracy of 85.30%, 78%, 78%, and 77.12% respectively.

articleTitle: Agriculture 4.0: Inculcation of Big Data and Internet of Things in Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Rapid increment in the adoption of digitalized technologies like the Internet of Things (IoT) and Big Data analytics in the agriculture sector to fulfill the increased demand for the food supply chain to inculcate the growing population. Agriculture 4.0 setbacks the revolution in the agriculture sector for growing demographics and implementation of various technologies changed the site of production. To better harness the technological innovation various insights and recommendations are provided for the step forward for achieving sustainable development goals. The adoption of various technologies like IoT and Big Data Analytics for Agriculture 4.0 is thoroughly evaluated in the current work. Finally, based on the thorough analysis of Agriculture 4.0 the challenges faced by the enabling technologies as well as the future recommendations or suggestions are provided for achieving sustainability as well as a new trend in the agriculture sector.

articleTitle: Detection of Guava Fruit Disease through a Unified Deep Learning Approach for Multi-classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Guava is a popular fruit grown widely in India and is also the largest guava exporter globally. With an annual production of 21.8 million tonnes, ensuring the quality of guava fruit by detecting diseases is crucial. In this study, we propose a deep learning (DL)-based model to classify guava fruit images as healthy or diseased and to identify three specific diseases: leaf spot, guava rust, and guava canker. The model is based on a combination of convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) algorithms, trained on a dataset of 6000 images. During testing, the model achieved a high accuracy of 95.90%, demonstrating its potential as a valuable tool for disease detection in guava fruit. This research provides a promising approach to accurately detect and classify diseases in guava, which can assist in maintaining high-quality fruit production and improve crop yield.

articleTitle: A YOLO-based Method for Improper Behavior Predictions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Deep learning (DL) algorithms have found extensive applications in the realm of intelligent policy contexts. In specific environments like waiting rooms and interrogation rooms, where actions such as physical assault and confrontations can pose serious risks, identifying and addressing improper behaviors is crucial. YOLO stands out as a prominent network architecture commonly employed for object detection tasks. In addition, SLTM-GCN represents an innovative DL model designed for predictive analysis utilizing unstructured data. To identify instances of inappropriate behavior in videos, this research leveraged both the YOLO and SLTM-GCN DL models. Consequently, this study makes a significant contribution by establishing the relevance of DL in the context of smart policing.

articleTitle: Modified Support Vector Machine to Improve Diabetic Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Data mining has become increasingly important in recent years for the capacity of the medical industry to anticipate illness outbreaks. The process of selecting, analyzing, and modelling massive amounts of dossier information with the goal of locating previously unknown connections or alliances that are significant to information researchers is known as “data mining.” Data mining is a technique. Diabetes is a condition that is induced by having an abnormally high amount of glucose fixation in the blood. Several different computational understanding systems that use various classifications to forecast and identify diabetes were explained. The choice of dependable classifiers unquestionably contributes to an increase in the precision and proficiency of the system. In this article, a technique is proposed that identifies data by utilizing an SVM classifier that has been altered. Within the scope of this investigation, we developed a computational model with the goal of improving diabetes forecasting.

articleTitle: A Microstrip Line-fed Slot Antenna with Inverted L-Shaped Stub for Application in Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: A microstrip line fed antenna with modified slotted characteristics with two stubs having inverted L-shape are symmetrically emerged from top right and left corners of the rectangular slotted section is designed in this paper. The designed antenna which is demonstrated here has the size of 32x40 mm2, which produces two resonance bands from 1.92 GHz to 4.23 GHz with 75.12 percentage bandwidth and from 5.33 to 6.17 GHz with 14.60 percentage bandwidth with the approximate central frequencies of 2.26 and 5.82 GHz respectively, which are the utilizing WLAN system of bands. The simulated gains of peak in nature of two bands of resonance are 2.45 and 2.65 dBi. The proposed designed antenna exhibited radiation patterns (RP) and gain of stable and nature of appropriateness.

articleTitle: Advanced Convolutional Neural Network Model to Identify Melanoma Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Today, a significant number of people are diagnosed with cancer of the skin. Melanoma and other types of skin cancer make up the vast majority of cases. The early detection and treatment of this cancer is the most wise and reliable technique for avoiding the development of the condition. The purpose of this research report is to offer a hybrid neural network model that can identify melanoma and non-melanoma skin malignancies with a higher degree of precision. This categorization model utilizes ACNN to integrate three different models. Both the training and evaluation of the model make use of two different benchmark datasets. In this investigation, the EfficientNetV2 model was used. This model showed better accuracy. The Inception layer of the model has been constructed, and the model’s overall accuracy is 98%. The model has a ROC value of 99, which stands for receiver operating characteristic. The model received a score of 97.5% on the F1 scale. As a main diagnostic procedure, this strategy is beneficial for patients as well as for clinicians, and it has the potential to reduce the death rate among skin cancer patients.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Machine Learning Algorithms and Ensemble Techniques for Hand Gesture Recognition using Electromyographic Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The measuring of electrical activity produced by muscular contractions is the objective of electromyography (EMG). In contrast, hand gesture recognition focuses on recognizing a specific gesture made with the hand. The methods for classifying and recognizing six hand motions based on electromyography (EMG) data are discussed in this paper. The experiment uses samples from 5 people from the UCI benchmark dataset of static hand motions. Two series are performed by the subject, each consisting of six (or seven) fundamental motions. Each motion was made for three seconds, followed by a three-second break. In order to recognize the hand movements, performance is assessed using machine learning agorithms. Some machine learning algorithms and ensemble approaches have been examined here for this study. A comparison of ensemble techniques and machine learning algorithms reveals that the bagging tree classifier-based system achieves the greatest recognition rate. With an average classification accuracy of 98.56%, the Bagged Trees model, among Ensemble algorithms was shown to have the best classification performance.

articleTitle: The Finest Convolutional Neural Network Model for Detecting Paddy Leaf Disease using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: There are over 30 different rice leaf diseases, some of which are common in Bangladesh and could cause significant economic and environmental problems. If these diseases are identified early and accurately, the damage they cause to crops and the losses they cause to farmers can be significantly mitigated. Researchers from all over the world have used a variety of methods and techniques to find diseases in rice leaves. The traditional disease detection method often needs to be more accurate and productive. Therefore, this study applies a novel approach with image processing and a convolutional neural network (CNN) to mitigate the constraint. This proposed methodology is designed to automatically sharpen the leaf images using an image filter, then apply CNN models. This work involved thirteen models in total; five models with “Resnet” architecture, four models with “Dense net” architecture, and four models based on “VGG” architecture. Here a raw dataset with 1600 images named “PaddyLeafBD” with four different classes is used, and gain the best accuracy among all of those models is 99.49% for VGG1$6_{-}$bn, Densenet-201, Densenet-161, Densenet-169, Resnet-18, Resnet-34, and Resnet-50 whereas least accuracy was 9S.4% for VGG-II and VGG-13.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Standardized Precipitation Index Selection using Geospatial Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Agricultural drought is a slow onset disaster that occurs due to a prolonged dry period in terms of deficiency of precipitation over a long period in the agricultural region as its negative impact on employment and national GDP measures. Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) based on Precipitation and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) encompass a substantial impact on the SPI-drought index due to the effectiveness of remote sensing and Geospatial techniques in tracking the spatiotemporal level of agriculture drought. The SPI plays a vital role to assess the drought condition. SPI computation accumulation can be done from 1 to 48 months. Identifying the best SPI accumulation scale is always a challenge for researchers. The objective of this research work is to determine the best SPIs using the raster precipitation index carried out at different timescales (1,3,6,9,12 months) since precipitation is directly proportional to the SPI index to determine the agriculture drought. To accomplish this research, a 31-year dataset (1991-2021) of precipitation is extracted from the agricultural drought-prone region-the Jaisalmer region of Rajasthan state from IMD Pune. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Correlation have been applied to find a correlation between precipitation and SPI. SPI-I and SPI-3 are selected as a good correlation of 0.82 and 0.65 and R-squared 0.49 and 0.39 respectively out of different timescales (1,3,6,9,12-months).

articleTitle: An Optimized Clustering Model for Energy-Efficient Routing in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The paper presents a novel approach for clustering in IoT networks, where energy-efficient routing is critical due to limited smart device capabilities. The proposed technique uses the Sandpiper optimization with Cycle Crossover Process (SOCCP) model to select cluster heads, considering various constraints such as distance, energy, security, and cluster radius. The clustering is performed using the optimized Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) algorithm, and the determination of the cluster head and radius is optimized through the SOCCP model. The proposed approach is evaluated using several metrics, including alive node analysis, risk analysis, and distance analysis. The results show that the proposed SOCCP model outperforms traditional clustering models, with lower risk and improved energy efficiency. Specifically, the distance analysis shows that the proposed method attains the minimum distance at the 1500th round, while traditional models exhibit higher values for the same round. The adopted approach holds promise for improving clustering in IoT networks.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stock Market Analysis by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The strategic planning, guiding, & control of financial initiatives constitute the crucial task of financial planning in businesses. This research article summarizes a study designed to show how artificial intelligence may be used to handle financial crises in a company or organization. The study discovered showed artificial intelligence supervision plays a crucial part in financial management and might be utilized to avert financial crises, lower risks, also enhance the efficacy & pattern of economic performance in a corporation. This was ascribed to artificial intelligence management’s capacity as a computer technology to create, process, & analyze massive volumes of data at once, comparative to when people are utilized, to assist management in making rapid decisions since the analysis’s findings are available at a faster rate. According to the study, artificial intelligence is essential for the oversight of financial concerns in a company, nation, or organization. This research made the recommendation that digital technologies be thoroughly incorporated into the financial industry in order to increase service availability and quality along with the development of unique regulations that promote positive competition amongst market players. Following this analysis, we offer important recommendations that might be implemented to enhance the financial system for the future.

articleTitle: Resolving Single-Sentence Answers for the development of an Automated Assessment Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The field of information retrieval systems includes question-answering systems. In the Question Answering system, the online examination was used to conduct tests and do the assessment online throughout the COVID-19 period. The majority of the work in question-answering systems has been done on objective-type questions, while researchers are currently working on descriptive-type questions. In this paper, we was creating a word-answer evaluation for an online objective exam. In objective-type questions, we created questions along with a model answer. The system database contains all the responses that students answered to the question, and it compared the student’s responses to the model response using similarity finding. However, the result was wrong when a response includes synonyms, misplaced words, or case sensitivity; this issue is not resolved by objective-type questions. Thus, we focused on the issues that are present in the online examination system. As result, the manual calculation was done on the responses submitted by students based on the Misplaced word, synonyms, and case sensitivity, and observed that this answer is correct but the system generate the wrong result.

articleTitle: Exploratory Review of Deep Learning Techniques for ECG Signals Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Deep learning technology has performed an advanced ECG signal-based heart monitor data. In this research prior heart attacks detection model’s analysis has been performed. Nearly 50 million people worldwide have cardiac problems, and 200,000 are detected annually. Therefore, an advanced study is required to handle future ECG signal-based heart problem detection. At the initial stage, pre-processing can be performed through the DWT filter. The second stage consists of CNN feature extraction, and the final step involves the classification of heart disease on an ECG graph. The ECG consists of alpha, beta, gamma, and delta waves in which all amplitudes notice and identify spikes. The performance measures like sensitivity 98.23%, accuracy 96.23%, Recall 97.34%, and F measure 94.75% have been attained. Atom Search optimization (ASO), Gray Wolf optimizer (GWO), RFO, and many more methods are outdated. Therefore, advanced deep learning technology is necessary to cross over the limitations of the present study. The proposed model attains more improvement and competes with current technology.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Detection Using Deep Learning: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The long history of facial expression analysis has influenced current research and public interest. The scientific study and comprehension of emotion are credited to Charles Darwin’s 19th-century publication The Representation of the Sentiment in Man and Animals (originally published in 1872). As Recognition of human emotions from images is one of the utmost important and difficult societal connection study assignments. One advantage of using a deep learning strategy is its independence from human intervention while undertaking feature engineering. This approach involves an algorithm that scans the data for features that connect, then combines them to promote quicker learning without being explicitly told to. Deep learning (DL) based emotion detection outperforms traditional image processing methods in terms of performance. In this analytical study, the creation of an artificial intelligence (AI) system that can recognize emotions from facial expressions is presented. It discusses the various techniques for doing so, which generally involve three steps: face uncovering, feature extraction, and sentiment categorization. This study describes the various existing solutions and methodologies used by the researchers to build facial landmark interpretation. The Significance of this survey paper is to analyze the recent works on facial expression detection and distribute better insights to novice researchers for the upgradation in this domain.

articleTitle: Proactive Horizontal Pod Autoscaling in Kubernetes using Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The management and implementation of distributed applications has been completely transformed by software containerization technologies. Before providing the containers to the clients, they must be correctly scaled. It is crucial that cloud service providers efficiently scale and distribute their resources and avoid under and over-provisioning of resources. Particularly, additional care should be taken for under provisioning of resources to avoid crashing of distributed applications. It is hard to manually assign resources to customers based on their continuously fluctuating workloads. The resource provisioning must be quick and automatic. Kubernetes provides a feature called autoscaler which allocates resources dynamically. However, the default autoscaler in Kubernetes is reactive as it will scale resources when load comes and allocation takes some time to get ready. This reactive nature may decrease the overall performance of application deployed. Hence, in this work, we present a proactive autoscaler mechanism that employs Bi-LSTM model to anticipate future demands and scale the containers automatically. The results using 3 node Kubernetes setup reveals that Bi-LSTM performs better than stacked LSTM and proactive autoscaler performs better than default Kubernetes autoscaler.

articleTitle: Estimation of Water Quality Parameters Using Water Indices and GEE
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: One of the biggest issues in the modern world is water pollution. Since the nation is still expanding, several new industries were being built daily. One of the primary causes of water contamination is this. Domestic trash that is deposited into water bodies is another problem. As a result, the pure water that is available to us is becoming significantly more contaminated every day. It takes a lot of time and manpower to measure the levels of water contamination. A developing technique called remote sensing is being utilized to compute many aspects of environmental research. We can calculate some water quality measures including turbidity, total suspended solids (TSS), and chlorophyll-A using remote sensing photos based on their reflectance property. In our study, we used data from remote sensing to construct the Normalized Difference Turbidity Index (NDTI) and the Normalized Difference Chloroform Index (NDCI) to determine the levels of turbidity and chloroform in the water bodies. This uses little labor and produces results in a very short time.

articleTitle: Parkinson’s Disease Diagnosis Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD), is a type of neurodegenerative disease, in the initial stages it targets the human brain and this is a slow process. The symptoms for this disease are constraint in muscles, shaking of limbs, and unusual balance, with time the given symptoms start getting worse. Within this paper, we have investigated and experimented with the usage of a VGG-19 model which is fine-tuned for diagnosing Parkinson’s Disease (PD) based on real-world images drawn by Parkinson’s Disease patients. Pre-processing of 102 wave & 102 spiral drawings from one of the sets of images and 368 wave & 368 meander drawings from the other set of images was done. The pre-processing included the scaling of images along with data augmentation to enhance the precision of the CNN. Training of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model was done on the images that underwent prior treatment. And validation was done with the help of the validation images. The accuracy of this model was determined to be 88% and 89% for the images in Set-1 and Set-2 respectively.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Observation on the Prediction of Diabetes Mellitus Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Diabetes disease has become as one of the common syndromes in many of the age groups. Diabetes can result in high blood sugar levels, a heart attack, or heart disease. This is one of the fastest developing illnesses, and it requires regular care. After seeing the doctor and being diagnosed, the patient is typically compelled to obtain their reports. Because this procedure is time-consuming and costly, we have the option of using ML approaches to solve this problem. Our research aims to foster a framework prepared to do all the more precisely foreseeing a patient’s diabetes risk level. To develop models, classification methods such as Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbor, Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest Classifier are employed. The results indicate that the techniques are quite accurate. The result showed that the prediction with the Logistic Regression model acquired the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Twitter Sentiment Analysis using Machine Learning Techniques: A Case Study of ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: ChatGPT is a powerful AI bot developed by OpenAI. This technology has the potential to generate a humanlike response. ChatGPT is a pre-trained system capable of generating chat and understanding human speech. This paper identified the responses of ChatGPT users through related tweets with the help of natural language processing and machine learning techniques. This paper uses textBlob, VADER and human annotation to find the sentiment of each tweet; countvectorizer is used for feature extraction and different machine learning algorithms to classify them into different classes. LeXmo is used to identify the various sentiment analyses, and it is observed that positive and trust emotions are higher than other sentiments. SVM with 10-fold cross-validation shows better results than other techniques.

articleTitle: Right To Shelter: A Technological Perspective in Smart Homes Through Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The use of virtual reality techniques in the sphere of smart home machines and devices is providing a new edge in the consumer’s convenience, change in routine living, and real-life monitoring within the synchronized wireless environment to provide them with the quick apt solutions within automated homes and shelter homes. A Virtual reality domain creates an interface between the user and the application environment by employing the Real-Time Simulator, Geometric construction system, and Application System. The basic attributes imbibed include – Immersion and Interaction techniques allowing smooth interaction between the user and the environment via easy language. In the changing domain, the requirement is to develop a mobile VR structure so that both VR and AR technologies can be used interchangeably providing a new dimension for the researchers to explore. To provide the user with the real experience of smart home surroundings, in addition, to upgrading the compatibility and connectivity between virtual-material objects it is also important to intensify the graphic quality of virtual devices. Hence the study recommends for its wider use, to create a controlled surrounding within the smart home and shelter homes for homeless people where both virtual modeling and virtual reality technology can be used equitably to make user’s life simpler and more convenient.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Stroke Prediction by using Machine Learning Implementations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Stroke disease is considered as a dreadful disease in which the blood circulation immediately stops from the brain to various parts of the body or suddenly bursts. It is also known as brain attack. In either case, the brain can be dead or damaged. It can further cause long-term disability, long-lasting brain damage, or even death even in developing countries. Out of these statistics, 5 million people are left permanently disabled, and another 5 million have died which is causing social burden. So, it is very important to detect the significant causes of occurring of the disease, so that treatment can be done accordingly and minimize the rate of future attacks. It acts as Machine learning (ML) methods can be a great solution to detect the causes and be better suited for more accurate predictions as these algorithms/ methods have the ability for improving their performances. This paper is intended to predict Stroke using various ML algorithms and to select which algorithm has the best performance. A total of 5110 data points has been taken along with 11 different attributes. Category dividers are trained and evaluated using different parameters. As a result, Random Forest Classifier (RF) has got the highest accuracy of 95.16% and is considered as the best ML method/algorithm for predicting stroke.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Detect Plagiarism in Bengali Textual Content using Similarity Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Plagiarism occurs when someone uses another person’s words or ideas without properly citing the original writers. It can be considered with or without the original author’s consent. This includes all manuscripts, print works, electronic works, and published and unpublished works. Detecting Bengali plagiarism has been the topic of several previous research. Numerous scholars have attempted to detect and prevent plagiarism using various methodologies and models, each with limits and drawbacks. Plagiarism detection in Bangla documents is uncommon and unavailable. As a result, this article developed a more efficient way that uses deep learning techniques to encode Bengali words and phrases as vectors using the word2vec and fasttext method. The proposed method was implemented to a Bengali Wikipedia dataset as well as original datasets collected by authors totaling 112,183 entries. In this study, the proposed model works effectively and can find both plagiarized and actual documents with a high accuracy of 100% based on data similarity and the extrinsic evaluation of the embeddings on a downstream NLP task, which is sentiment analysis, with a high accuracy of 91.4% using word embeddings generated by fasttext. Cosine similarity outperforms Jaccard similarity techniques in this suggested model.

articleTitle: Autism Spectrum Disorder: Automated Detection based on rs-fMRI images using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) impacts approximately 1 in every 160 children globally and is classified as a neurodevelopmental condition. Image classification in neuroscience has advanced primarily due to convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and their capacity to provide better algorithms, more computing resources, and data. This study used a brain scan dataset to test the feasibility of utilizing CNN to detect ASD. Using functional connectivity patterns, the Autism Brain Imaging Exchange (ABIDE) data repository, which includes recordings of rest-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), the aim of using it was to distinguish between individuals who have Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and those who are healthy controls. The proposed method effectively classified the two groups. According to the test findings, the suggested model has the ability to accurately detect ASD with a reliability rate of 92.22% when implemented on the ABIDE dataset using the CC200, CC400, and AAL116 brain atlases. The CNN model is computationally more efficient since it uses fewer parameters than other cutting-edge methods.

articleTitle: Node Overlapping Detection for Draggable Node-Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Node-based interfaces are user interfaces that are based on the concept of nodes, which represent individual units of functionality, and edges, which represent the connections between nodes. In a node-based interface, nodes are connected by edges to form a graph, which represents the data flow and relationships between different parts of the system. The Node overlapping detection technique is only for react flow version 11 and higher. Users having previous versions are not able to use that functionality. To detect the overlapping, based on the output of this library, several user-defined functions can be used to resolve to overlap. It will see the single-pixel overlap. Using this library, users can avoid Node and edge overlapping by creating custom edges. It is a simple JavaScript function currently used for reactjs. In the future, if any other script develops a draggable node-based flowsheet-creating feature, the user can use this library accordingly.

articleTitle: Binary Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm: A Binary Version of Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm for Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The Artificial hummingbird algorithm which is given by Mirjalili in 2022 is a swarm-based meta-heuristic technique. This technique shows better results than many classic techniques when compared and tested by the Wilcoxon test the AHA shows better results and has found applications in different real-life problems like in the energy sector. In this work, the binary version of the code for various optimization algorithms provided by various researchers serves as inspiration for developing the binary version of the artificial humming algorithm to solve discrete optimization problems. The binary AHA is evaluated on the benchmark functions and the results are compared with the original AHA algorithm at different dimensions.

articleTitle: Light-UNet++: A Simplified U-NET++ Architecture for Multimodal Biomedical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Abstract-Images have been the most comprehensive data source in the field of healthcare but have likewise been one of the most challenging ones to analyze. Deep Learning, since its inception, has revolutionized the realm of medical imaging, investigation, and diagnosis. Conventional CNN algorithms gave fair results in more manageable image segmentation problems but could not prove themselves on complex ones. That is where U-NET++ comes into the picture, architecture for fast and precise segmentation of images. Because of its ability to combine low-level and high-level information, U-NET++ demonstrated its strength in medical image segmentation. Low-level erudition aids in improving accuracy, whereas high-level erudition aids in efficiently extracting complex features. A wide range of experiments were carried on various datasets. Despite excellent overall performance in the segmentation of multimodal medical images, it is noticed that the conventional U-Net architecture requires modifications in certain areas. The proposed approach consists of a U-NET++ architecture with a modified pooling function. Instead of max pooling, the model uses mixed pooling, a combination of max pool and avg pool. The accomplishment of the proposed design has been tested and delivers impressive results on datasets. The model achieved an F1 score of 0.9069, with a sensitivity of 0.9984 and a specificity of 0.8075. The model’s accuracy was 0.9966, with a Jaccard score of 0.6885 and a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.0033. Additionally, the model achieved a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) area under the curve (AUC) score of 0.9029. The findings suggest that the results outperform the metrics of the existing U-NET++ architecture, thereby establishing the effectiveness of the proposed Light-UNet++ architecture for image segmentation tasks. Since early detection of any abnormality is crucial, the method will help in a timely and accurate diagnosis to launch appropriate treatment at the earliest possible stage.

articleTitle: Wearable Patch Antenna with Rectangular Slots and Defected Ground for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper presents the performances of a wearable microstrip patch antenna with partial ground structure for medical applications, which is works in ISM Band (2.4-2.55GHz). A substrate material which is FR-4 with a relative dielectric, ${E}_{\mathrm{r}}$ of 4, 4, loss tangent, of 0.02 and thickness, h of 1.5 mm has been selected in our antenna design. The patch and the ground consist of copper and have a height of 0.035 mm each. The antenna dimensions measure $60\times 53\mathrm{~mm}^{2}$. To achieve the upper resonant frequency of 2.48 GHz, some slots were incorporated into the radiating patch. The simulations of the proposed antenna demonstrate a reflection coefficient (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>) of −52.69 dB at 2.48 GHz, accompanied by a 10-dB bandwidth of 150 MHz and a gain of 2.22 dB. The calculation of the VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio) was also performed and the achieved value is 1.0112, which means that our antenna has a very good impedance matching.

articleTitle: Basketball Shot Prediction Using 2nd Order Polynomial Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Monitoring basketball is the most important and difficult functionalities in sport’s analysis because of how fast the game moves. The purpose of this study is to describe a computer vision-based method for detecting ball features, tracking the trajectory of ball, and estimating the likelihood that the ball will strike the basket. On the video frame depicting the sporting event, HSV-based color segmentation is utilized to locate and identify the basketball. The mask that contains the features of area and centroid is used to detect the shape of the ball. It is necessary to trace the path that the ball travels in order to gather information regarding the exact position of the ball in each respective frame. The second-order polynomial regression is utilized to produce predictions regarding the trajectory that is followed by the ball as well as the likelihood that it will contact the base. The actual path and the predicted path that was followed are almost identical. The accuracy of the proposed method is 97.98%.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis Using Retinal Fundus Images through MobileNetV3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a major disease throughoutthe world. Diagnosis of diabetes at an early stage is so critical and could help save several lifestyles. One out of two individuals experiencing diabetes has been determined to have some phase of DR. Recognition of DR symptoms in time can turn away the vision weakness inmost the cases, nonetheless, such disclosure is troublesome with present devices and strategies. Existingmethods for determining whether a person is suffering from diabetes or maybe the chances of acquiring diabetesrely heavily on examiners. Most of the time, it can be treated if caught during the early stages. There is a need for creating models that are efficient and robust to detect DR holistically. In recent times the advent of Deep learning models has been used extensively in various Bio medical applications. In this work, we utilize a Hyper parameter tuned MobileNet-V3 model based on a multi-stage Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to efficiently classify images from the IRDID dataset. A Multiclass classification model involving images collated from various sources were trained, validated and tested for classification accuracy. The network was evaluated based on parameters and the network was able to achieve an accuracy of 88.6%

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm based Feature Selection to Enhance Breast Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: A crucial data pre-processing step in data mining is feature selection. Choosing a subset of potential features by removing attributes with essentially no predictive value and heavily related redundant features appears to be the main goal of feature selection. We proposed a model that uses GA (Genetic Algorithm) for choosing or selecting these potential features. our model takes the set of features from the input data and then based its processing it encode it with either 0 or 1 which indicates the exclusion or inclusion the that feature. We use the Breast Cancer dataset for comparing the accuracy of different classification algorithms before applying the Genetic Algorithm and after applying it. We apply this feature selection method to different classifiers like RandomForest, Decision Tree, AdaBoost, Linear SVM, and a few others. With the help of the selected features, the accuracy of the model increases by 2.09% which outperformed the accuracy of a classification model which uses RandomForest classifier. This paper describes how Genetic Algorithms (GAs) help in selecting potential features for different classifiers.

articleTitle: Indian Coin Detection Algorithm Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The purpose of this essay is to classify Indian coins of various denominations. Identification of the coins and calculation of their total value in Indian National Rupees are the objectives (INR). The system uses image processing in the MATLAB tools section and edge detection technologies to identify coins. The properties of modern and historic coins of various denominations are taken into consideration for classification. Indian coins come in a variety of values and are categorized based on their shape, size, surface, weight, area, centroid, and other physical attributes. Other countries’ coins have the same specs but different values. This research is concerned with affine transformations, such as rotation, shearing, and straightforward grey level scaling. By using zooming techniques to increase the coin size in the photograph, the coins are clearly visible. To implement the coin categorization, MATLAB code is written, and it is tested using simulated results.

articleTitle: Data Analysis on Hypothyroid Profiles using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms enable computers to learn from data and continuously enhance performance without explicit programming. Machine learning algorithms have significantly improved the accuracy and efficacy of thyroid diagnosis. This study identified and analysed the usefulness of several machine-learning algorithms in predicting hypothyroid profiles. The main goal of this study was to see the extent to which the algorithms adequately assessed whether a patient had hypothyroidism. Age, sex, health, pregnancy, and other factors are among the many factors considered. Extreme Gradient Boosting Classifier, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Long-Term Memory, and K-Nearest Neighbors are some of the machine learning methods used. For this work, two datasets were used and analysed. Data on hypothyroidism was gathered via DataHub and Kaggle. These algorithms were applied to the collected data based on metrics such as Precision, Accuracy, F1 score and Recall. The findings showed that the Extreme Gradient Boosting classification method outperformed the others regarding F1 score, accuracy, precision, and recall. The research demonstrated how machine learning algorithms might predict thyroid profiles and identify thyroid-related illnesses.

articleTitle: Implementing Firefly Optimization Inspired Optimized Tuning of Fractional Order (FO) PID Controller for Yaw Angle Control for an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The direction and depth of hybrid automated guided vehicles are guided by actuators within the vehicle rather than external controls. These automobiles were modelled after underwater gliders. The goal of this study is to create the proper thrust and rudder angle positions to achieve the required heading. In order to control the above heading, we create a controller with two loops, one of which is under the direction of a PD controller and the other by a FOPID control action. With the aid of We construct a nonlinear dynamical model of the vehicle based on the hydrodynamic forces and coupling between the vehicle and the interior moving mass. In order to control the vehicle’s heading angle around a predetermined path, a fractional order PID controller is designed using the model to examine the stability of the horizontal-plane motion of the object. In comparison to ACO and PSO, the simulated results demonstrate the system’s resilience, performance increase, and reduced error when employing FA-FOPID.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface-Assisted OFDM-IM for Beyond 5G Mobile Networks: ML and LLR Detector Designs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The several countries of the world is intensified their investigative on the fifth generation and beyond (5GB) communications in order to reach the new requirements for new wireless applications. In this context, orthogonal frequency division multiplexing with index modulation (OFDM-IM) concept is suggested as one of the ideal solutions in the literature. Additionally, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) can be occupied to enahance the quality of service (QoS). Considering that, the performance of RIS-assisted OFDM-IM system is examined by applying maximum likelihood (ML) and log-likelihood ratio (LLR) detectors in this paper. It is observed from the provided computer simulation results that integrating an RIS consisting of many low-cost and passive elements, into OFDM-IM systems considerably increase the overall system performance.

articleTitle: Classification of the Severity Levels of Apple Rot Disease: A Hybrid Dual CNN and LSTM Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The fruit industry experiences significant economic losses due to various diseases affecting apple crops annually. Early diagnosis of these diseases is crucial to prevent the intensity of the disease and to ensure the production of healthy crops. In this study, we propose a novel hybrid model for the multi-class classification of apple illnesses that blends convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks. The proposed model was trained and evaluated on a dataset of images of apple fruit images exhibiting different severity degrees of black rot disease. Experimental results depict the hybrid model outperformed traditional single-model approaches, achieving an overall accuracy of 96.5% classification of the disease. This demonstrates the potential of combining CNNs and LSTMs to achieve high accuracy in complex image classification tasks, particularly in the field of plant disease diagnosis. Our proposed model can provide a valuable tool for apple farmers, researchers, and extension workers in the early detection and management of apple diseases, thereby improving crop yields and minimizing economic losses.

articleTitle: Permuted layer-based CNN for Emotion Detection with Multi-Modality Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Human emotion detection is a challenging task. Emotions are expressed via facial expressions, body/face temperature, EEG recordings, voice recordings. In this paper, a novel CNN based model is reported to detect human emotion using multimodal human emotion representation data. The model is based on the concepts of one-dimensional convolution on the permuted-ensembled feature space representing EEG signals. The model addresses the issues with localized one-dimensional convolution over high-dimensional feature spaces and attempts to improve the classification performance. Results indicate improved detection accuracy over different emotions as compared to other popular machine learning approaches.

articleTitle: Brain tumor detection using histogram equalization and deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: A brain tumor puts one’s life in danger and interferes with the body’s regular operations. If a brain tumor is correctly predicted, people’s lives can be saved; if the prediction is incorrect, people could die. Clinical specialists must complete a complex and lengthy procedure called brain illness prediction, and their performance is based on their level of competence. In order to successfully treat the patient, the earlier prediction offers information about the patient’s brain status. Deep learning (DL) algorithms can be used to resolve complicated and nonlinear situations. The proposed solution used Kaggle dataset, which consists of 253 brain MRI images, 155 of which are said to include tumors. Data Augmentation and Histogram Equalization can be utilized to effectively find the Brain Tumor. Various deep learning (DL) methods, such as VGG-19, can be used to improve classification and prediction accuracy. In this work, we examined the accuracy of the CNN model both before and after histogram equalization with VGG-19. It has been demonstrated that the new models are much more accurate than the ones currently in use. In our research, VGG-19 achieved accuracy scores of 99.99% for training, 98.45% for testing, and 98.44% for validation.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Systems for Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In the field of cloud computing, resource sharing, and task prioritization are primary problem domains. These problems can be resolved with efficient resource allocation. An efficient resource allocation enhances the resource utilization of cloud systems. But, the hierarchical design of cloud systems (with many devices communicating and behaving in complex ways) makes designing and stability of resource allocation algorithms difficult. Software-based agents have the important characteristic of being autonomous, as they adapt to different conditions based on requirements. Multi-agent systems aid in coordination among several agents. In this article, the algorithm we present develops a unique method for an agent system-based resource allocation in a cloud environment with reinforcement learning techniques. The algorithm shows an improvement in resource utility, resource availability, and resource scalability over static resource allocation. Compared to the multi-agent systems work in the field, the algorithm shows a good improvement with regard to these performance parameters.

articleTitle: Clustering in Cognitive Radio Networks Using Blockchain: Issues & Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Wireless technology advancements have led to a scarcity of available spectrum, despite the numerous new wireless applications being developed. Cognitive Radio (CR) is a promising technology that enables the efficient utilization of available spectrum by unlicensed users. Cognitive radio networks (CRNs) can be centralized or distributed, with the latter being an ad hoc network. However, the dynamic nature of CRN poses several challenges, including maintaining networks topology, connectivity, and stability. Clustering is a popular technique used to address these issues. However, it has limitations such as central unit failures and intercommunication overhead. This paper proposes the use of blockchain technology as a solution for clustering in CRNs. The paper discusses how blockchain's features such as adaptability, connection reliability, and security can benefits the CRN clustering process. Furthermore, various clustering algorithms and their limitations are explored, and compared with blockchain-based clustering. The findings suggest that blockchain-based clustering can effectively address the challenges of CRNs.

articleTitle: A Robust and Secure Image to Multi-Images Steganography
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: With the enhancement in technology sharing of information in different forms like text, images or videos is being adopted worldwide. But this sharing of information also led to cybercrime, to overcome this image steganography approach has been widely used in which messages in the form of text, image or video can be enclosed within another image which will be invisible to other users. This research paper proposed an enhanced method of image steganography by concealing the secret image within several cover images, each of which conceals a portion of the secret image that has already been encrypted with a key. By partially blending into these cover images, secret images can be transmitted through comparable or other open channels more reliably and securely.

articleTitle: TSDRDL: Traffic Sign Detection and Recognition using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The recognition and detection of traffic-signs are crucial components of expert systems, including automated driving and traffic assistance systems. These systems rely on quickly detecting and identifying traffic-signs to ensure safe and efficient driving. This research proposes a novel method for accurately detecting and recognizing traffic-signs in real-world situations. The approach involves pre-processing images by converting them to grayscale and filtering them. The traffic-signs are then classified into subclasses using a convolutional neural network (CNN) with filtered input images and the same parameters as the detection stage. The CNN architecture parameters are optimized to achieve the highest recognition. The Experimental-results demonstrate the CNN architecture outperforms prior studies regarding accuracy. Overall, this research offers a promising approach to improving the reliability and efficiency of automated driving and traffic assistance systems.

articleTitle: Predicting Rice Leaf Disease Outbreaks using CNN-SVM Models: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The critical component in machine learning for classifying image features. Creating a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) opens the door to the possibility of significant returns and the identification of diseases affecting rice. The 5932 on-field images in this publication depict four distinct rice leaf diseases: bacterial blight, Blast, brown spot, and tungro. Additionally, the transfer learning method and the deep feature support vector machine were used to evaluate the performance of 11 CNN models (SVM). The simulation findings demonstrate that the proposed method is inferior to the deep SVM equivalent in classification performance. Convolutional neural network layers were used to develop the classification module, which offers an accuracy of up to approximately 70%. An average accurate recognition rate of 96.8%, and this study examines previous studies on picture classification using CNN. This accuracy is more significant than conventional back propagation neural network models. This work offers a fresh approach to the further investigation of various diseases.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis of Two and Three Unit Standby System along withGoodwill Loss using Regenerative Point Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In this study, a two-unit and three-unit standby system with variable demand is compared. The two models under consideration for comparison are Model 1, a two-unit system, and Model 2, a three-unit system, both of which have a standby facility and the ability for all units to become operational depending on demand while accounting for Goodwill loss that may manifest in Model 1. The installation cost impact of the new unit is also investigated, same as in Model 2, where an extra unit is introduced to make up for goodwill loss. By using a graphical analysis of the MTSF and profit functions, the two systems are compared. The various measures of both systems have been examined using the semi-Markov process and regeneration point technique.

articleTitle: The Efficiency of Ensemble Machine Learning Models on Network Intrusion Detection using KDDCup 99 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: With the advent of data communication the increased usage of the technologies results in network intrusions and associated attacks. Consequently, the data violation rates are increased abundantly and that sacrifices Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability. This article focused on the network Intrusion Detection System (IDS) that detects various attacks and types. Machine learning (ML) has the potential to spot known-experience and Zero-day attacks. Consequently, the article has considered ML and ensembled models for the various attack classification. The major contributions of the current article are 3 -fold. Initially, to understand the relevance and sufficiency of the dataset through exploratory data analysis. Second, the comprehensive understanding of the various attacks, its nature, various types and classifications and finally, the empirical analysis of the dataset through the potential of various ML models. The article utilized various discriminative models for the execution and all of the models have shown better accuracy. The tree-based ensemble model, Random Forest has outperformed the rest of the models with higher accuracy in the training and testing samples of 99.997 % and 99.969 % respectively.

articleTitle: Detecting Deepfake Human Face Images Using Transfer Learning: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Deepfake technology has made it easy to create realistic, manipulated videos and images, raising concerns about the potential for them to be used to spread misinformation or harm individuals. Deepfake technology has advanced significantly in recent years, making it increasingly difficult to distinguish between real and fake images. This has raised concerns about the potential for deepfake images to be used maliciously, for example, in political propaganda or cyber fraud. As a result, there is a growing need for effective methods of detecting deepfake images. So, it became important to propose an effective classification on deepfake. In this paper the authors have proposed an effective classification on deepfake images using Transfer Learning. This approach will help in classification of Real and fake through Human face images. The authors have utilized Real vs Fake Face classification dataset to apply the proposed approach. The Loss, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, AUC, and F1 Score parameters have been used to analyze the performance of proposed approaches. The outcome of this work shows the EfficientNetV2L Model with the accuracy of 99% as compared among EfficientNetV2B0-B3 and S, M, L models.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Hybrid PLC-VLC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Visible light communication (VLC) is becoming more popular as spectrum scarcity becomes a serious issue for wireless communication. Availability to the base network, on the other hand, will probably alter the system for communication, incurring significant costs. Power line communication (PLC) technology appears to be an excellent fit for VLC, providing electricity and connecting VLC to the backbone system. In the present paper a hybrid PLC- VLC has been experimentally demonstrated with very less budget as well as low complexity. For PLC and VLC channel, Frequency Shift Keying (FSK) and On-Off Keying (OOK) modulation technique has been implemented. In the VLC system, 4× 1 MISO system has been employed. A pulse signal has been generated from the MATLAB Simulink and this signal has been transmitted through PLCMISO-VLC channel. All the waveforms of the signal have been traced on Digital Oscilloscope (DSO) successfully.

articleTitle: Hyperparameter Optimization of Machine Learning Models for Monitoring Menstrual Mental Health
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Monitoring and tracking mood disorders associated with Menstruation are becoming crucial to avoid impairment in the mental health of a woman, prevent disruption in family life and relationships, and allow women to maintain a proper balance in their work life. Every sentiment linked during the menstruation cycle can be identified for improving fecundability and health management. This study aims to analyze the feelings of women during Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD) and the actual menstrual cycle using text-mining methods. We used sentimental analysis in a Reddit dataset to identify positive and negative emotions in women. In the proposed framework, public sentiments were first processed and data was balanced using Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) followed by classification using different machine learning frameworks like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree Classifier, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, AdaBoost Classifier and Boosting Classifier. The findings of this study exhibit that women evoke both positive and negative sentiments. However, compared to other feelings the negative emotion is at its inception. The result shows that Random Forest with tuned hyperparameters gives us the best accuracy of 94% when compared to other baseline and ensemble machine learning models with different feature extraction techniques.

articleTitle: Depression Detection Through User’s Social Network Interactions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Depression is a medical condition that causes mood disorders making the person feel sad or have no interest in things they usually liked to do. In our society, depression has become a significant health issue that people typically do not address. A person might fall into depression because of past events, the loss of a loved one, economic problems, or other reasons. For our survey, we needed to choose relevant papers on depression. The selection of the documents was a rigorous process, as the research papers had to undergo a thorough screening to ensure they were relevant to our survey. In this survey paper, various approaches other scholars took toward detecting depression were studied and analyzed. We have prepared a comparative survey between Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) models pinpointing the differentiating factors. After reviewing the shortlisted documents, common limitations are identified in almost all the research work conducted thus far. After completing this survey, we conclude that analyzing a user’s data from their social media platform will help find out whether they are depressed or not. We can see the changes in a person’s behavior over a while through social media interactions. We also found that DL models were superior to ML models when the size of the datasets increased.

articleTitle: Data Analysis and Machine Learning Observation on Production Losses in the Food Processing Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Food wastage and capturing lineage from production to consumption is a bigger concern. Yielding, storage and transportation areas have evolved to a great extent associated to manufacturing and automation which lead to technical advancements in food processing industry. In such situation, losses are generally observed in the crop production which are sometimes minimal and ignored. However, in some cases these losses are huge and are becoming a threat to the both producers and consumers. Here we considered data related to dairy products and analysed the production losses especially while processing them in the treating unit. Literature on parameters and associated data analysis in the form of graphical representation are provided in the appropriate sections of the paper. Linear regression and correlation were envisaged in view of incorporating machine learning techniques understanding production losses. Karl Pearson’s correlation provides an observation related to association of parameters which are desired to be less coupled in terms of employing proposed newer methodology.

articleTitle: Design and Development of secure RFID Based Health Card for integrating Various Health Services
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The goal of this research is to design and implement a secured RFID-based health monitoring system that utilizes a database management system (DBMS) to store and manage patient health data. The system utilizes RFID tags to track patients’ vital signs, such as heart rate, oxygen level, body temperature, and store the data in a secure DBMS. This allows authorized healthcare providers to easily access and retrieve patient data, providing a convenient and efficient way to monitor the health of patients and track their progress over time. To ensure the security of the system, a secure communication pro-tocol is implemented between the RFID reader and the DBMS. This prevents unauthorized access and ensures that the data is transmitted and stored in an encrypted format. Additionally, the system includes a user authentication process that only grants access to authorized healthcare providers. The system is designed to be low-cost, easy to use, and portable, making it suitable for use in a variety of healthcare settings. The system was tested and evaluated, and the results indicate that it is accurate and reliable, with a high level of security. In conclusion, this secured RFID-based health monitoring system provides a valuable tool for healthcare providers by allowing them to monitor the health of patients in a convenient and efficient manner. It also ensures that patient data is secure and protected from unauthorized access.

articleTitle: Insider Threat Classification Using KNN Machine-Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The insider threat has grown to be a broadly conventional problem, and it has become the most predominant demanding situation in the field of cybersecurity. This system shows that threats require a unique method of detection, techniques, and various tools that can simplify correct and speedy malicious insider detection. As insiders live at the back of the organizational level and regularly have access to the network, detection, and prevention of insider threats become very complicated. Later, a few issues are brought up based on the findings from the examined work, and new gaps and difficult circumstances are identified. This paper represents an up-todate review of all major machine learning algorithms employed for detecting insider threats. Moreover, various issues involved during the formulation of multiple algorithms for detecting insider threats are discussed.

articleTitle: An Advanced Cuckoo Search Algorithm Based-Reliability Improvement of An Islanded Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Microgrids have become popular to meet the demands of electrical energy in various fields of industry, agriculture, services and daily life due to their flexibility, effectiveness, and especially support and encouragement of the exploitation and exploration of local renewable energy sources. To ensure efficient and reliable operation in steady-state as well as fault conditions, the microgrid should have an optimal protection system. This paper proposes to improve the reliability of an islanded microgrid using an advanced cuckoo search (CS) algorithm. This proposal is applied to RBTSIEEE-6 bus power system. The advanced CS algorithm-based achievements are compared with those by using other algorithms to validate the proposal.

articleTitle: A Compatible Hexadecimal Encryption-Booster Algorithm for Augmenting Security in the Advanced Encryption Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Among the most prominent encryption algorithms, Advanced Encryption Standard ranks first. Even so, many familiar characters can be seen when an AES encrypted file is opened. As of today, there have been very few contributions to research on suppressing known characters in AES encrypted files. It is possible to identify encrypted files not only by their name and content, but also by their size. As a result, hackers can identify files at source and target locations by comparing their sizes. In this paper, a methodology is presented to address these two research gaps. As a result of the proposed algorithm, almost all characters are transformed into an unintelligible format not only for humans, but also for computer interpreters. As an additional benefit, the proposed method makes the encrypted file appear smaller and conceals its actual size. The proposed Encryption Booster algorithm is also easily integrated with Advanced Encryption Standard.

articleTitle: Analysis of Consumer Behavior Toward Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This study is based on the analysis of consumer behavior towards the adoption of electric vehicles. The purpose of the analysis is to understand how consumers perceive the electric vehicles in real-world scenarios which will help in understanding the consumer in more depth and helpful in optimizing their services. Currently the industry is dealing with factors such as vehicle driving range, suitable battery technology, capable charging infrastructure which needs to be developed according to Indian conditions considering the sensitive price market. Considering the initial shift of automotive industry, how the consumers perceive this change will be a deciding factor for the adoption of the technology, so to further bring more clarity to the influencing factors this research has been done. The study was conducted by interviewing industry experts and the consumers of the electric vehicle to understand the overall scenario of the EV sector. The basic information regarding user groups and the experts has been segregated to bring more clarity regarding the profiles and current adoption trends in the sector.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of BERT Embeddings on Rumor Debunking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Social media allows us to connect and share information with anyone within seconds. Most users access social media through web-based applications on their mobile phones. The ease of information sharing through social media results in the exchange of large amounts of information among its users. This could lead to the spread of rumours, either unintentionally or intentionally. Whichever is the case, rumours can hurt concerned users and sometimes even lead to dire situations. It is impractical to manually filter out rumours from trillions of pieces of information. Thus, various research works have been going on for automatic rumour detection. In this paper, we propose a new way to look at research that has already been done to see how BERT embeddings help find rumours. The proposed model was put through 10-fold crossvalidation. Compared to the baseline implementation, subtask A got better by 3.2% and subtask B got better by 2.9%.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Assistance in the Domain of Law
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In early times, all legal documentation, outcomes and decisions were completely organic and dependent on human inputs. They would be tediously time-consuming and would result in delayed judgments. The onset of industry 4.0 brought upon new toolkits to automate most processes & decisions based off of previous data logs. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is performing human tasks with much more accuracy and soon will be capable of taking over most compound processes. AI and the legal domain are not a new concept and through the advancement in the field, collaboration could help in achieving the needs of the future. In this review, the sustainable use of AI in law is examined and the challenges arising out of it are studied. The outcome of AI in law gives the essence of a more tech-driven world in the future and the tools of AI, although based on a philosophical process when used alongside the human being, has a rule-based process bringing about an effective and efficient solution to the problem.

articleTitle: Identifying Question Intent Similarity Using Computational Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Paraphrase identification is becoming an important use case in the industry. From a business context, paraphrase identification is significantly helpful to improve the user experience of the platform. It is an active research area by companies like Quora, Stack Overflow, and other question-answering websites. One of the main issues that these companies face is the problem of repeating questions. If one is successfully able to capture and interpret the semantics of the sentence and the intent of the user, this would improve the consumer experience. Quora’s official dataset was used in the present research work. To find a question that was similar, we modeled the dataset of Quora question pairs. It was a Binary classification task and various approaches were explored and experimented with. Bag of Words was used for feature extraction. A traditional machine learning approach was followed and algorithms like XGBoost, RF, and decision tree were used. These models were evaluated based on their F-1 and accuracy scores. Feature engineering was performed that significantly improved the model accuracy. The decision tree model was able to achieve an accuracy of up to 78.8% while Random Forest and XGBoost had an accuracy of 76.2% and 75.4%.

articleTitle: Estimation of Community Water Consumption Using Multivariate Ensemble Approach.
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Water consumption prediction is an important application of Time Series forecasting, as it has various real-life applications. Judicial usage and optimal management of water are imperative and accurate forecasting is a key component in achieving those goals. This paper explores a novel multivariate ensemble approach for forecasting future water consumption, using a combination of Machine Learning and Statistical Modelling. The models used in this project are SARIMAX, Prophet and XGBoost. The models are trained individually on the data and their respective results are then used to predict the final output. The final ensemble model can forecast up to 36 months of data into the future. The model was able to output results with scores of 360.075 MSE, 18.976 RMSE, 15.814 MAE, and 0.027 MAPE.
